title: UN Commission finding on displacement of released Gaza detainees
summary: The Commission assessed restrictions on released detainees returning to northern Gaza and attacks on civilians attempting to return.
claim: The Commission found that prohibiting released detainees from returning to northern Gaza constituted forced displacement and that attacks on civilians attempting to return to their families amounted to forcible transfer.
legal_characterization: War-crime and crime-against-humanity findings by a UN commission of inquiry; not a judicial judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 110 of A/79/232. The record preserves the Commission's legal characterization and does not present the finding as a court judgment.
